name: ATEN eco PDU
description: ATEN eco PDU range (PE6108G and siblings) over the Telnet CLI on port 23. Per-outlet on/off/reboot control and per-outlet power metering; device-level voltage and total power draw. Polled every 5 minutes by default.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: PDU IP or host. Port 23 is the ATEN Telnet default; append :port to override.

config_schema.name: username
config_schema.description: The PDU's Telnet username. This is a separate account from the web interface login; PE-series PDUs typically ship with teladmin.

config_schema.name: password
config_schema.description: That Telnet user's password (typically telpwd until changed). Wrong credentials show the PDU offline with "login rejected".

config_schema.name: poll_rate
config_schema.description: How often to read outlet state and power. Leave blank for every 5 minutes. Each reading is its own Telnet login, so faster polling adds load on the PDU; outlet names are re-read hourly.

config_schema.name: tags.outlet_count
config_schema.description: Override the outlet count for non-PE6108G models. Defaults to 8.

config_schema.name: tags.outlet_N_name
config_schema.description: Optional per-outlet label override (e.g. tags.outlet_1_name: 'Codec'). Wins over the name configured on the PDU itself.

example_config:
- id: rack-a-pdu
  name: Rack A PDU
  type: power
  protocol: aten_pdu
  address: 192.168.90.10
  username: teladmin
  password: ${ATEN_PASSWORD}
  poll_rate: 300s

name: NETGEAR M4250 / M4350
description: NETGEAR AV Line fully managed switches over the CLI on Telnet port 23. Identity, uptime, temperature, fans and power supplies; PoE budget; per-port link, speed and PoE draw; PoE power-cycle and port control.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: Switch management IP or hostname. Port 23 is the Telnet default; append :port to override.

config_schema.name: username
config_schema.description: Switch user with Privileged EXEC (admin) access.

config_schema.name: password
config_schema.description: That user's password.

config_schema.name: poll_rate
config_schema.description: How often to poll. Each poll logs in and runs six show commands; 60s suits most sites.

config_schema.name: tags.enable_password
config_schema.description: Enable password, if one is set on the switch. Blank by default.

config_schema.name: tags.port_prefix
config_schema.description: Prefix added to a bare port number in port commands. Defaults to 0/ (M4250); use 1/0/ for an M4350 or stack unit 1.

example_config:
- id: av-rack-switch
  name: AV Rack Switch
  type: control
  protocol: netgear_m4250
  address: 192.168.1.2
  username: admin
  password: ${NETGEAR_PASSWORD}
  poll_rate: 60s

name: Aurora RXT-x Touch Panels
description: Wall-mount control touch panels. JSON-RPC over Telnet on port 6975, with proximity, lux, and relay control.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: Panel IP or hostname (port 6975 is implied).

config_schema.name: username
config_schema.description: Login username if the panel is secured.

config_schema.name: password
config_schema.description: Login password if the panel is secured.

example_config:
- id: reception-panel
  name: Reception Touch Panel
  type: control
  protocol: aurora_rxt
  address: 192.168.1.50
  poll_rate: 30s

name: Aurora VPX Series
description: AV-over-IP encoders and decoders. JSON over Telnet on port 6970; encoder vs decoder mode is auto-detected at connect.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: Encoder or decoder IP (port 6970 is implied).

config_schema.name: poll_rate
config_schema.description: How often to poll. Defaults to 60s.

example_config:
- id: boardroom-vpx
  name: Boardroom VPX Decoder
  type: avoip
  protocol: aurora_vpx
  address: 192.168.10.20
  poll_rate: 30s

name: Aurora DIDO
description: 4x4 HDMI matrix switchers and video wall processors. JSON over TCP on port 6970: video and audio routing, output resolutions, volumes and presets.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: DIDO IP (port 6970 is implied).

config_schema.name: poll_rate
config_schema.description: How often to poll. Defaults to 60s.

example_config:
- id: court3-dido
  name: Court 3 DIDO
  type: control
  protocol: aurora_dido
  address: 192.168.10.30
  poll_rate: 60s

name: Crestron control processors
description: 3-Series and 4-Series control processors through their console, over SSH (or CTP). Model, firmware, uptime and load, the program loaded, and every IP-ID device the program registers, with online or offline for each. No change to the room's program.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: Processor IP (SSH port 22 is implied; 41795 with the console tag set to ctp).

config_schema.name: username
config_schema.description: A processor user that can log in to the console.

config_schema.name: password
config_schema.description: That user's password.

config_schema.name: poll_rate
config_schema.description: How often to poll. Defaults to 60s.

example_config:
- id: court3-cp4
  name: Court 3 processor
  type: control
  protocol: crestron
  address: 192.168.10.40
  username: admin
  password: ${CRESTRON_PASSWORD}
  tags:
    program_slot: "1"

name: Poly VideoOS
description: Studio X and G7500 conferencing codecs. REST with session/XSRF login lifecycle; reads work in appliance (Teams / Zoom Rooms) mode, writes lock.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: Codec base URL including scheme.

config_schema.name: username
config_schema.description: Local admin username.

config_schema.name: password
config_schema.description: Local admin password.

example_config:
- id: studio-x70
  name: Boardroom Studio X70
  type: conferencing
  protocol: poly_videoos
  address: https://192.168.20.30
  username: admin
  password: ${POLY_PASSWORD}
  tags:
    lens_managed: "true"

name: Cisco RoomOS
description: Cisco collaboration devices running RoomOS: Room Kit, Room Bar, Board, Desk and Codec series. xAPI over HTTPS with a local Admin user; call control, standby power, audio and the device's own diagnostics.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: Device address. HTTPS is assumed; include http:// only if HTTP has been enabled on the device.

config_schema.name: username
config_schema.description: Local user with the Admin role.

config_schema.name: password
config_schema.description: That user's password.

config_schema.name: tags.tls_skip_verify
config_schema.description: Set to "true" to accept the device's self-signed certificate, which RoomOS uses unless you've installed your own.

example_config:
- id: boardroom-roomkit
  name: Boardroom Room Kit
  type: conferencing
  protocol: cisco_roomos
  address: 192.168.20.40
  username: marcus
  password: ${CISCO_PASSWORD}
  tags:
    tls_skip_verify: "true"

name: Cisco TC (TC7)
description: Cisco TelePresence codecs on TC software (TC7.x): SX, MX, EX, C and Profile series. The same xAPI as RoomOS, with TC's standby and reboot commands and support for its older HTTPS.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: Codec address. HTTPS is assumed; TC also enables HTTP by default, so http:// works if HTTPS gives trouble.

config_schema.name: username
config_schema.description: Local user with the Admin role (admin by default on TC).

config_schema.name: password
config_schema.description: That user's password.

config_schema.name: tags.tls_skip_verify
config_schema.description: Set to "true" to accept the codec's self-signed certificate.

example_config:
- id: meeting-room-sx20
  name: Meeting Room SX20
  type: conferencing
  protocol: cisco_tc
  address: 192.168.1.19
  username: admin
  password: ${CISCO_PASSWORD}
  tags:
    tls_skip_verify: "true"

name: Philips Professional Displays
description: Philips professional and signage displays over SICP on TCP port 5000. Power, inputs, volume, mute and backlight; temperature, signal presence, operating hours and identity. Wake-on-LAN for power-on from deep standby.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: Display IP or hostname. Port 5000 is the SICP default; append :port to override.

config_schema.name: tags.monitor_id
config_schema.description: The display's Monitor ID (1–255), set in its menu. Defaults to 1.

config_schema.name: tags.mac_address
config_schema.description: MAC address for Wake-on-LAN, so power_on works when the display's network sleeps in standby.

example_config:
- id: reception-signage
  name: Reception Signage
  type: display
  protocol: philips_sicp
  address: 192.168.30.50
  tags:
    monitor_id: "1"
    mac_address: AA:BB:CC:11:22:33

name: Sony Bravia Professional
description: Bravia Professional Displays. JSON-RPC REST with Pre-Shared Key authentication and Wake-on-LAN power-on support.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: Display base URL (http:// is fine on the LAN).

config_schema.name: password
config_schema.description: Pre-Shared Key configured on the display.

config_schema.name: tags.mac_address
config_schema.description: MAC for Wake-on-LAN. Discovered automatically once the display is powered on; set explicitly if power_on must work from a cold start.

example_config:
- id: waiting-room-tv
  name: Waiting Room Display
  type: display
  protocol: sony_bravia
  address: http://192.168.30.40
  password: ${BRAVIA_PSK}

name: Biamp Tesira
description: Tesira DSPs over TTP (Telnet). Subscription-based metrics; commands are TTP strings you define per device.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: DSP IP (Telnet port 23 is implied).

config_schema.name: username
config_schema.description: Login username, if login security is enabled on the Tesira.

config_schema.name: password
config_schema.description: Login password, if login security is enabled on the Tesira.

config_schema.name: commands
config_schema.description: Named TTP command map (<instance tag> <verb> <attribute> <channel> [value]). Each entry becomes a button in the portal; {name} placeholders are prompted for when the button is pressed.

config_schema.name: subscriptions
config_schema.description: Push-notification subscriptions. Each becomes a live metric.

example_config:
- id: main-hall-dsp
  name: Main Hall Tesira
  type: audio
  protocol: tesira
  address: 192.168.40.10
  commands:
    mute: master_level set mute 1 true
    unmute: master_level set mute 1 false
    toggle_mute: master_level toggle mute 1
    vol_up: master_level increment level 1 3
    vol_down: master_level decrement level 1 3
    set_level: master_level set level 1 {level}
    recall_preset: DEVICE recallPreset {preset}
  subscriptions:
    - tag: master_level
      attribute: level
      channel: 1
      label: master_level_db
      rate: 500

name: VISCA-over-IP (PTZ cameras)
description: Sony VISCA-over-IP on UDP 52381. Cross-vendor: works with Sony BRC/SRG, Panasonic AW-UE, PTZOptics, HuddleCam, Marshall CV, Lumens VC-A61P and other VISCA-compliant PTZ cameras.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: Camera IP or host. Port 52381 is the Sony default; append :port to override.

config_schema.name: poll_rate
config_schema.description: How often to inquire power/zoom. Defaults to 30s.

example_config:
- id: boardroom-cam
  name: Boardroom PTZ
  type: camera
  protocol: visca_over_ip
  address: 192.168.50.20
  poll_rate: 30s

name: Generic REST
description: HTTP GET-based polling for devices that expose a plain REST endpoint. Use as a starting point when no vendor adapter fits.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: Full URL to the endpoint being polled.

config_schema.name: username
config_schema.description: HTTP Basic username if the endpoint requires auth.

config_schema.name: password
config_schema.description: HTTP Basic password if the endpoint requires auth.

example_config:
- id: custom-rest-device
  name: Custom REST Device
  type: control
  protocol: rest
  address: http://192.168.50.10/api/status
  poll_rate: 60s

name: Generic WebSocket
description: Long-lived WebSocket connection with periodic keep-alive probes. Suitable for devices that push state as JSON frames.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: ws:// or wss:// URL of the endpoint.

example_config:
- id: custom-ws-device
  name: Custom WebSocket Device
  type: control
  protocol: websocket
  address: wss://192.168.60.10/socket

name: Generic Telnet
description: Raw line-oriented Telnet transport. Custom command strings sent as configured; useful for legacy AV gear.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: host:port of the Telnet endpoint.

config_schema.name: commands
config_schema.description: Named command strings sent on demand from the portal.

example_config:
- id: custom-telnet-device
  name: Custom Telnet Device
  type: control
  protocol: telnet
  address: 192.168.70.10:23

name: Generic Serial (RS-232)
description: Direct RS-232 to a device wired to the collector host. Baud rate configurable; commands sent as raw byte strings.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: Serial device path on the host running the collector.

config_schema.name: baud_rate
config_schema.description: Baud rate. Defaults to 9600.

example_config:
- id: projector-rs232
  name: Auditorium Projector
  type: display
  protocol: serial
  address: /dev/ttyUSB0
  baud_rate: 9600

name: ICMP Ping
description: Network reachability probe. Sends ICMP echoes and records loss and latency. Use for devices with no vendor API — a switch, an unmanaged panel, an IP camera.

config_schema.name: address
config_schema.description: IP address or hostname to probe.

config_schema.name: tags.ping_count
config_schema.description: Packets per probe cycle. Defaults to 3.

config_schema.name: tags.ping_timeout_ms
config_schema.description: Per-packet timeout. Defaults to 1000ms.

example_config:
- id: floor-2-switch
  name: Floor 2 Access Switch
  type: control
  protocol: ping
  address: 192.168.80.10
  poll_rate: 60s
